Plot model parameter estimates, correlations, and pairwise posterior distributions

Source: R/S7-generics.R, R/S7-plot-methods.R
plot_parameters.Rd

Visualizes category parameter estimates (means, covariance ellipses, SDs, correlations), parameter correlation matrices across MCMC draws, and pairwise posterior parameter scatter/contour matrices for category representations, templates, cognitive models, and fitted Stan models.

Usage

plot_parameters(
  x,
  pars = NULL,
  categories = NULL,
  groups = NULL,
  ndraws = 100,
  combine_into_single_plot = TRUE,
  index_panels = FALSE,
  ...
)

plot_parameter_correlations(
  x,
  pars = NULL,
  categories = NULL,
  groups = NULL,
  cues = NULL,
  ndraws = 100,
  ...
)

plot_parameters_pairwise(
  x,
  pars = NULL,
  categories = NULL,
  groups = NULL,
  cues = NULL,
  ndraws = 100,
  ...
)

## S7 method for class <MVBU_CognitiveModel>
plot_parameters(
  x,
  pars = NULL,
  categories = NULL,
  groups = NULL,
  ndraws = 100,
  combine_into_single_plot = TRUE,
  index_panels = FALSE,
  ...
)

## S7 method for class <MVBU_Stanfit>
plot_parameters(
  x,
  pars = NULL,
  categories = NULL,
  groups = NULL,
  ndraws = 100,
  combine_into_single_plot = TRUE,
  index_panels = FALSE,
  ...
)

## S7 method for class <MVBU_Stanfit>
plot_parameter_correlations(
  x,
  pars = NULL,
  categories = NULL,
  groups = NULL,
  cues = NULL,
  ndraws = 100,
  ...
)

## S7 method for class <MVBU_Stanfit>
plot_parameters_pairwise(
  x,
  pars = NULL,
  categories = NULL,
  groups = NULL,
  cues = NULL,
  ndraws = 100,
  ...
)

Arguments

x

An MVBU object (MVBU_CategoryRepresentation, MVBU_CategoryRepresentationTemplate, MVBU_CognitiveModel, or MVBU_Stanfit).

pars

Character vector of parameter names to filter in plot_parameters, plot_parameter_correlations, and plot_parameters_pairwise. Defaults to NULL (all parameters).

categories

Character vector of category names to include. Defaults to NULL (all categories).

groups

Character vector of group names to plot for MVBU_Stanfit objects. For plot_parameters, defaults to all groups including the prior. For plot_parameters_pairwise and plot_parameter_correlations, defaults to "prior".

ndraws

Integer specifying the number of posterior MCMC draws to sample for plotting parameter distributions. Defaults to 100L.

combine_into_single_plot

Logical; if TRUE (default), combines multi-panel parameter subplots into a single unified figure via patchwork. If FALSE, returns a named list of individual ggplot panel objects.

index_panels

Logical; if TRUE, adds panel index labels (A, B, ...) to multi-panel figures. Defaults to FALSE.

...

Additional arguments passed to specific parameter plotting methods.

cues

Character vector of cue names to plot (1, 2, or 3 cues). Defaults to all cues of the model up to 3 (or the first 3 cues if the model has more than 3 cues, analytically marginalizing out all remaining dimensions). At most 3 cue dimensions can be plotted simultaneously.

Value

A ggplot object (or list of ggplot objects if combine_into_single_plot = FALSE).

Details

In parameter plots, scale is displayed as standard deviation \(\tau = \text{SD} = \sqrt{\text{diag}(\boldsymbol{\Sigma})}\) (or the expected standard deviation \(\sqrt{\text{diag}(\mathbf{S}) / (\nu - D - 1)}\) for NIW/NIX models), while off-diagonal covariances are plotted as dimensionless correlation coefficients \(\rho \in [-1, 1]\).

plot_parameter_correlations displays a correlation heatmap of Pearson correlation coefficients (\(\rho\)) computed across MCMC draws for all parameters across categories and selected groups. Parameters for distinct groups form separate rows and columns without averaging across groups. Parameter names indicate category, cue, and group index in their subscripts (with subscript 0 denoting the prior group). Gray bounding boxes along the diagonal group parameters belonging to each category.

plot_parameters_pairwise displays a matrix of pairwise parameter relationships across categories and groups. The lower triangle shows sample scatterplots with LOESS trendlines; the diagonal displays marginal posterior auto-densities scaled to panel height; and the upper triangle displays 2D posterior density contour lines (geom_density_2d with normalized density contours). Points and curves are colored by group.

See also

plot_categories, plot_categorization_functions, get_parameters, get_draws

Examples

mod <- example_mvg_ideal_observer(n_cues = 2)
plot_parameters(mod)
